description: Phase 4 — POS UI on web AND mobile with parity. Web admin tabs/routes + lib/pos.ts data layer + billing/inventory/import/history/access screens; mobile expo-router screens + src/pos.ts, JS/TS only with no new native module (mobile Excel is web-only per design §9.2). Search by name/SKU/barcode, cart, qty +/- and decimal custom units, totals, payment, save/reopen, history. Depends on FEAT-002 (billing API) and FEAT-003 (import API). Grounded in web ADMIN_TABS/canAdmin in pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx, adminData.ts react-query pattern, and the mobile app/admin/orders.tsx guard pattern.
steps: web: run `npm --prefix ...\web install` first (worktree has NO node_modules).
web/src/lib/pos.ts: react-query hooks over lib/api.ts following pages/admin/adminData.ts (search, bills CRUD, hold/reopen, history, inventory, import preview/commit, bulk-update, phones).

web/src/pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx: add tabs to ADMIN_TABS — New Bill (key 'pos'), Billing History (key 'pos'), Inventory (key 'inventory'), Excel Import (key 'inventory'), Sales Reports (key 'pos_reports'), POS Access (owner-only); the existing canAdmin(role,perms,key) filter hides them from unauthorised staff.
web/src/App.tsx: add the /admin routes for the six components.

web/src/pages/admin/AdminPos.tsx: responsive two-pane search/scan + cart; +/- steppers; decimal qty field for weight units; barcode = fast-burst Enter -> exact SKU/barcode lookup; idempotencyKey via useRef per cart (reused on retry); payment method; minimal-click Charge calling POST /api/pos/bills.

web/src/pages/admin/AdminPosHistory.tsx, AdminInventory.tsx, AdminPosImport.tsx (upload -> preview table with row errors -> commit; bulk-update; export), AdminPosAccess.tsx (phone allowlist, owner-only). (AdminPosReports.tsx is populated in FEAT-006.)
mobile/src/pos.ts: react-query over src/api.ts following src/queries.ts.

mobile/app/admin/pos.tsx, pos-history.tsx, pos-bill/[billNo].tsx, inventory.tsx, pos-import.tsx (explains Excel runs on web; offers bulk/single edit via the same /api/admin/pos endpoints — NO file picker, no new native module), pos-access.tsx (owner). Follow the app/admin/orders.tsx guard (canAdmin + router.replace('/login')). Single-column thumb-reachable billing layout. (pos-reports.tsx is populated in FEAT-006.)
acceptance_criteria: A bill can be created on web by selecting products and changing quantities (acceptance c); the same idempotencyKey is reused across retries.
POS tabs/screens are gated by canAdmin so unauthorised staff never see them (frontend hide is in addition to the server guards, not instead of).
Web search finds products by name, SKU and barcode; qty supports decimals for weight units.
Mobile screens compile and follow the existing admin guard pattern with no new native module.
`npm --prefix ...\web run build` exits 0; `npm --prefix ...\mobile run typecheck` is clean for touched files.
verification: Run `npm --prefix c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing\4astore-v2\web install` then `npm --prefix ...\web run build`; must exit 0.
Run `npm --prefix ...\mobile install` then `npm --prefix ...\mobile run typecheck`; clean for touched files.
findings:
Phase-4 POS UI (web + mobile parity) complete. KEY FILES/SYMBOLS for later features (esp. FEAT-005 share actions + FEAT-006 reports):

WEB DATA LAYER — web/src/lib/pos.ts (react-query over lib/api.ts, same pattern as adminData.ts). Exported TYPES reused across screens + FEAT-005: PosProduct, PosBillItem, PosBill (full serialized bill incl. items[], server totals subtotal/tax_total/grand_total/amount_paid, payment_method/status, status 'held'|'completed'|'cancelled'|'refunded'), CreateBillLine, CreateBillPayload, ImportPreview/ImportPreviewRow, ImportBatch, ChangeLogEntry, AdminPhone. HOOKS: usePosProductSearch(q) (debounce by passing q; enabled when non-empty), posLookupExact(code) (one-shot exact SKU/barcode->first-result, used for scan/Enter), useCreateBill/useHoldBill (mutations), usePosBills(filters,limit)/usePosBill(billNo)/fetchPosBillById(id) (reopen held), useCancelBill/useRefundBill, useImportPreview (FormData multipart)/useImportCommit/useBulkUpdate/useImportHistory/useChangeLog, exportProductsXlsx() (blob->download), usePosPhones/useUpsertPhone/useRemovePhone (DELETE). All request shapes match FEAT-002 routes/pos.ts + FEAT-003 routes/pos-import.ts + admin-pos.ts verbatim.

WEB SCREENS — web/src/pages/admin/: AdminPos.tsx (two-pane responsive search/scan + cart; +/- steppers; decimal qty input for weight units g/kg/mg/ml/l via DECIMAL_UNITS; Enter = barcode scan -> posLookupExact; idempotencyKey held in a useRef per cart and REGENERATED only after a successful charge so retries stay idempotent while the next bill is a new op; Charge POSTs /pos/bills, Hold POSTs /pos/bills/hold; ?reopen=<id> rehydrates a held bill). AdminPosHistory.tsx (filterable list + BillDetail; EXPORTS `BillCard` which takes an OPTIONAL `actions?: React.ReactNode` slot — FEAT-005 should inject the 5-action toolbar there; cancel/refund wired via useCancelBill/useRefundBill). AdminInventory.tsx (search + inline price/stock edits -> bulk-update selling_price|stock; Export Excel; change-log table). AdminPosImport.tsx (upload->preview table w/ per-row action+errors->commit; import history). AdminPosReports.tsx (FEAT-006 placeholder). AdminPosAccess.tsx (owner-only phone allowlist; uses store/confirm showConfirm).

WEB NAV/ROUTES — web/src/pages/admin/AdminApp.tsx ADMIN_TABS got 6 rows: New Bill(key 'pos'), Billing History('pos'), Inventory('inventory'), Excel Import('inventory'), Sales Reports('pos_reports'), POS Access(key 'posAccess'). The existing canAdmin(role,perms,key) filter hides them from unauthorised staff; owner-only POS Access uses key 'posAccess' which is NOT in ALLOWED_PERMS, so only owner/superadmin (who short-circuit canAdmin) ever see it. Routes added in web/src/App.tsx under /admin: pos, pos-history, inventory, pos-import, pos-reports, pos-access. Frontend hiding is IN ADDITION to the server requireStaff/requireOwner guards.

MOBILE DATA LAYER — mobile/src/pos.ts mirrors the web hooks over src/api.ts (same names + types + money helpers round2/round3/isDecimalUnit/DECIMAL_UNITS). NOTE: extended mobile/src/api.ts RequestOpts.method union to add 'DELETE' (one word) so useRemovePhone can call DELETE /admin/pos/phones/:mobile — the GET-only auto-retry branch is unaffected (DELETE is a write, never retried) and the 401-refresh path is method-agnostic. No other api.ts change.

MOBILE SCREENS (expo-router, JS/TS only, NO new native module) — mobile/app/admin/: pos.tsx (single-column thumb-reachable billing; Crypto.randomUUID() from expo-crypto for the per-cart idempotency key; Stepper from components/ui; decimal qty field for weight units; scan via onSubmitEditing->posLookupExact), pos-history.tsx, pos-bill/[billNo].tsx (bill detail + cancel/refund; FEAT-005 adds the 5 share actions here using src/native.ts openWhatsApp + the expo-print path in src/invoice.ts), inventory.tsx (per-product price/stock edit via bulk-update), pos-import.tsx (EXPLAINS Excel import is web-only per design §9.2, NO file picker; links to Inventory + shows change-log), pos-access.tsx (owner-only), pos-reports.tsx (FEAT-006 placeholder). Every screen follows the app/admin/orders.tsx guard: `useEffect(if ready && !canAdmin(user,perm) router.replace('/login'))`; pos-access/roles use isOwner. ENTRY POINTS added to app/(tabs)/profile.tsx admin card, each wrapped in canAdmin(user,perm)/isOwner so unauthorised staff never see them.

VERIFICATION — `npm --prefix ...\web run build` exits 0 (only the pre-existing >500kB chunk-size warning). `npm --prefix ...\mobile run typecheck` clean. `npm --prefix ...\mobile test` = 64/64 pass (no new mobile test added here — pure POS math lives in api-node posBilling and FEAT-005 adds the invoice-footing test). Online storefront/orders/catalog untouched; all additions are new files + additive nav/route lines + the one-word api.ts method-union extension. FEAT-005 integration point: web BillCard `actions` slot + mobile pos-bill/[billNo].tsx action area; both render PosBill with server totals verbatim (no recompute).
